The unanswered working set — orders in `NEW`, the ones the acknowledgement sweep acts on.

Only this list is exposed, deliberately. It is the only listing whose size is an operational signal; a general "all orders" endpoint would answer no question anybody has while something is wrong.

Keyset-paginated (fleet REST guideline section 3): ordered by (`acknowledgeBy`, `networkRef`), so orders sharing a deadline are never skipped or repeated across pages. Follow `nextCursor` until it is absent. Any query parameter other than `limit` and `cursor` is a 400 `unknown-query-parameter`.
